genotype_to_drug_rule: Reads Mykrobe JSON susceptibility.<drug>.predict: 'R'->R, 'S'->S, 'r'->I (counted separately, never S), 'N'/'U'/'F'->no_call, unknown token or crash->failure.

i_handling.description: Mykrobe emits 'r' (minor allele / intermediate resistance) alongside 'R', 'S', and 'N'/'U'/'F'. Every 'r' call maps to canonical 'I', is counted separately (i_r, i_s), and is never mapped to S.
